questions.question:
The line graph shows the scores of a batsman in 6 matches. In how many matches was his performance better than the previous match?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3533280f2b5a14cf6c06aecbb41d0dfa9cc65ccec0962283b4f0fbec79a5547f.png]
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Increase in 2nd match from 1st match = 17 - 10 = 7

Increase in 3rd match from 2nd match = 51 - 17 = 34

Increase in 4th match from 3rd match = 45 - 51 = -6

Increase in 5th match from 4th match = 63 - 45 = 18

Increase in 6th match from 5th match = 39 - 63 = -24

**∴ In 3 matches his performance was better than the previous match.**

questions.question:
The line graph shows the production (in tonnes) and the sales (in tonnes) of a company.

What is the ratio of the productivity of the company in 2015 and 2016 taken together to the sales in 2017 and 2019 taken together?

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bed017748eb8929e7489799afc408435ca0236b98b57e299bc1ef3c332255b9.png]
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Production of the company in 2015 and 2016 taken together = 600 + 628 = 1228

Sales in 2017 and 2019 taken together = 500 + 516 = 1016

∴ Required ratio = 1228 : 1016 = 307 : 254

questions.question:
The line graph shows the production (in tonnes) and the sales (in tonnes) of a company.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a01aff322fec1baef1029eba8172494ddc89f787cf3704f598016ac3d568d40f.png] 

What is the percentage of maximum increase or reduction in the production of the company in comparison to the previous year?
questions.solution:
Percentage change in production from 2015 to 2016 = (628 - 600)/600 × 100% = 4.67%

Percentage change in production from 2016 to 2017 = (750 - 628)/628 × 100% = 19.42%

Percentage change in production from 2017 to 2018 = (750 - 500)/750 × 100% = 33.33%

Percentage change in production from 2018 to 2019 = (570 - 500)/500 × 100% = 14%

**∴ 33.33% is the percentage of maximum increase or reduction in the production of the company in comparison to the previous year.**

questions.question:
The given line graph shows the production (in tonnes) and the sales (in tonnes) of a company.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/738e48a6cd71245072df23af4c422408e3b4811bafd6368fa22e2f74781d1c60.png] 

What is the difference (in tonnes) in the production in 2015 and 2017 taken together and the sales in 2018 and 2019 taken together?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of production in 2015 and 2017 together = (600 + 750)

⇒ 1350

Total number of sales in 2018 and 2019 together = (400 + 516)

⇒ 916

The difference in the production in 2015 and 2017 taken together and the sales in 2018 and 2019 taken together = (1350 – 916)

⇒ 434

**∴ The required difference is 434**

questions.question:
Study the line graph and answer the question that follows.

The line graph represents the number of vehicles (in thousands) manufactured by two automobile companies A and B over the years from 2010 to 2015. The X-axis represents the years and the Y-axis represents number of vehicles in thousands.

(The data shown here is only for mathematical exercise. They do not represent the actual figures of the country.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b67c7871db341fbcdf001918543a0550ad51f6aa8be9d00b48b07a4ba5b128eb.png] 

The average value of the vehicles manufactured by Company A is what per cent of the average value of the vehicles manufactured by Company B during 2010 to 2015?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total value of vehicles manufactured by company A during 2010 - 2015 = 260 + 218 + 224 + 179 + 266 + 348 = 1495

Average value of vehicles manufactured by company A during 2010 - 2015 = 1495/6 = 249.16 (in thousands)

Total value of vehicles manufactured by company B during 2010 - 2015 = 307 + 270 + 250 + 289 + 310 + 416 = 1842

Average value of vehicles manufactured by company B during 2010 - 2015 = 1842/6 = 307 (in thousands)

**∴ Required percentage = 249.16/307 × 100 = 81.2%**

questions.question:
Study the following line graph and answer the question based on it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af45ce6a7409fce1f0f3017acff3ed5d488c33b95cf0352c195da2ce6ee38f32.png] 

The production of Company Y in 1998 was approximately what percent of the production of Company X in the same year
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The production of Company Y in 1998 = 120000

The production of Company X in 1998 = 99000

Required percentage = (120000/99000) × 100

⇒ (40/33) × 100%

⇒ 121.2%

**∴ The production of Company Y in 1998 was approximately 121.2% of the production of Company X in the same year.**

questions.question:
The line chart given below shows the production (in 10000 s) of cars in 7 different months.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/685f8ed133d73a4c035becf39f9f812d22057edc0b8c41e7e6da5ee315cc5368.png] 

Production of cars in month M4 is what percent of the production of cars in month M2?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

A line chart which shows the production (in 10000 s) of cars in 7 different months.

**FORMULA USED:**

Percentage = (quantity1/quantity2) × 100

**CALCULATION:**

Production of car in Months M4 = 24

Production of car in Months M2 = 32

Percentage = (24/32) ×100 = 75%

questions.question:
The line chart given below shows the production (in 10000s) of cars in 7 different months.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3a293eadc800fef3d4dccb9807f5f4bf83f3776d8404c46a8b37c7ebfd0abb6.png] 

Production of cars in month M2 is how much percent more than the production of cars in month M1?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

From the line chart,

Production of cars in month M1 = 25

Production of cars in month M2 = 32

Difference in Production of cars from month M1 to M2 = 32 – 25 = 7

**∴ The required percentage = (7/25) × 100 = 28%**
